mapper.select:
SELECT R.*, I.IMG_PATH FROM RALLY R INNER JOIN ( SELECT RALLY_NO, MIN(IMG_PATH) AS IMG_PATH -- 대표 이미지 한 개만 선택 FROM RALLY_IMG GROUP BY RALLY_NO ) I ON R.RALLY_NO = I.RALLY_NO WHERE 1=1
AND ( R.RALLY_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR TO_CHAR(R.RALLY_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR R.APPLICATION_PERIOD LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR R.PRICE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR R.PHONE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR R.TYPE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR R.HOST LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY R.RALLY_NO DESC OFFSET ( (#{page} - 1) * #{pageSize} ) ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY
